mapper.insert: INSERT INTO m_user_notification_setting ( user_id, notification_group, enabled, create_user_id, create_program, created_at, update_user_id, update_program, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{notificationGroupCode}, #{enabled}, #{operatorUserId}, #{program}, NOW(6), #{operatorUserId}, #{program}, NOW(6) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled), update_user_id = VALUES(update_user_id), update_program = VALUES(update_program), updated_at = NOW(6)
